name: GdeltForge
what_it_holds: Apache-2.0, recently updated (11 Sep 2026) tool that forges raw GDELT archives (Events, GKG, Mentions) into cleaned, reproducibly-sampled, cross-referenced Parquet files for downstream analysis.
why_useful: Could shortcut building a clean, joined Events+GKG+Mentions Parquet pipeline instead of writing one from scratch; useful plumbing for a GDELT-based travel/regulatory news nowcast.
time_coverage: depends on GDELT archive range pulled
themes: News and event databases: GDELT tooling, Google News scrapers, travel-industry news datasets (Skift, PhocusWire), regulatory news trackers
why_all: Could shortcut building a clean, joined Events+GKG+Mentions Parquet pipeline instead of writing one from scratch; useful plumbing for a GDELT-based travel/regulatory news nowcast.

name: es-gdelt
what_it_holds: Indexes the entire GDELT events database (including the 15-minute real-time feed) into Elasticsearch for query/aggregation.
why_useful: An alternative ingestion path if a searchable/aggregatable store of GDELT events is wanted instead of flat files; niche but functional (14 stars, still starred/updated recently for a 2025 repo).
themes: News and event databases: GDELT tooling, Google News scrapers, travel-industry news datasets (Skift, PhocusWire), regulatory news trackers
why_all: An alternative ingestion path if a searchable/aggregatable store of GDELT events is wanted instead of flat files; niche but functional (14 stars, still starred/updated recently for a 2025 repo).

name: Global-News-Intel-Platform
what_it_holds: MIT-licensed, actively updated (7 Sep 2026) end-to-end pipeline ingesting 100K+ daily GDELT events into MotherDuck/DuckDB with Dagster orchestration and a text-to-SQL chat interface, built to run at $0/month on free tiers.
why_useful: A ready-made low-cost orchestration pattern for standing up a continuously-updating GDELT store filtered to Airbnb/travel/STR-regulation keywords, if the team wants an ongoing news-event nowcast feed rather than one-off pulls.
size_hint: 100K+ events/day ingested, no historical backfill dataset committed
themes: News and event databases: GDELT tooling, Google News scrapers, travel-industry news datasets (Skift, PhocusWire), regulatory news trackers
why_all: A ready-made low-cost orchestration pattern for standing up a continuously-updating GDELT store filtered to Airbnb/travel/STR-regulation keywords, if the team wants an ongoing news-event nowcast feed rather than one-off pulls.

name: gdelt-downloader
what_it_holds: Python script to bulk-download GDELT GKG data with proxy rotation, weekday/hour filtering, resume capability, and file validation -- built for large/robust historical backfills.
why_useful: Practical for pulling a long historical GKG backfill (rather than the live Doc API's shorter-window queries) if a multi-year Airbnb/travel-news tone series is wanted; robustness features (resume, validation) matter for a multi-day bulk pull.
themes: News and event databases: GDELT tooling, Google News scrapers, travel-industry news datasets (Skift, PhocusWire), regulatory news trackers
why_all: Practical for pulling a long historical GKG backfill (rather than the live Doc API's shorter-window queries) if a multi-year Airbnb/travel-news tone series is wanted; robustness features (resume, validation) matter for a multi-day bulk pull.

name: GoogleNews (Iceloof)
what_it_holds: Python scraper of Google News search results: title, media source, date, description, link per query; filter by language, region, custom date range. MIT, 135 commits. No bundled data.
why_useful: Could build a point-in-time news-volume proxy for Airbnb / STR-regulation / travel-demand keyword mentions by date, filterable to specific windows around guide dates -- cheap alternative to paid news APIs. Fragile to Google blocking at scale.
time_coverage: current + custom date ranges (not a fixed historical archive)
themes: News and event databases: GDELT tooling, Google News scrapers, travel-industry news datasets (Skift, PhocusWire), regulatory news trackers
why_all: Could build a point-in-time news-volume proxy for Airbnb / STR-regulation / travel-demand keyword mentions by date, filterable to specific windows around guide dates -- cheap alternative to paid news APIs. Fragile to Google blocking at scale.
